Careers

At Glotman•Simpson, our team is our foundation.

Not only technically skilled and innovative, we are passionate, creative and committed to excellence.

Providing high-quality solutions for over 5,000 projects has a great deal to do with our people.  Our team is our foundation; not only technically skilled and innovative, we are passionate, creative and committed to excellence. Glotman•Simpson’s culture is collaborative, both within our team and with our clients.  Working together, we combine creativity and insight to arrive at solutions that are fresh and innovative.  By attracting and retaining the best talent in the industry, our people are committed to delivering superior client service. We believe in providing an environment where careers flourish.  Through offering numerous in-house training programs, on-the-job mentoring and encouraging regular professional development activities, we support continuous life-long learning and growth.

Join our team!

Joining Glotman•Simpson means joining our 60+ year legacy and having a hand in collaborating on some of the most iconic structural landmarks alongside a team of great people. If you’re a solutions-oriented individual who’s passionate about being involved in our teams inspiring work, we want to hear from you.
